subject: 四层狮奴
prompt:
CRITICAL: NEWLY COMPLETED CLEAN POLYCHROME SCULPTURE, before any decay. NOT an aged antique. No chipped paint anywhere, including base and extremities. Create ONE high-resolution photorealistic reference-guided reconstruction of the SINGLE specific Yingxian Wooden Pagoda sculpture in the attached reference, not a generic Buddhist statue. Portrait 1024x1536. Strict centered straight frontal near-orthographic camera at sculpture mid-height, symmetrical framing, FULL requested figure and attached base with 5% margin, no cropping. Neutral light-gray seamless studio backdrop, soft even diffuse illumination, sharp face and exact fingers, all in focus. Preserve the exact sculpted facial proportions, eyes, smile, body pose, garment folds, headdress, number of arms, hand positions and visible iconographic details of this specific reference. Material is realistic handmade ancient painted clay sculpture, mineral pigments and gilding, NEVER living human skin, wax, glossy plastic or cartoon/CGI. Clear shape separation suitable for 3D modeling. Isolate from temple, other figures, columns, halos not actually present, offerings and photographic clutter. No captions, lettering, watermark, panels or collage. Image is an AI interpretation, not documentary evidence; metadata outside image will say this. Subject-specific visual observations: A single robust boyish male animal attendant sculpture, small topknot, round upturned face with slightly raised chin, brow lines and ear ornaments. Dynamic WIDE LUNGE: RIGHT leg viewer LEFT stretched diagonal outward, LEFT leg viewer RIGHT bent. RIGHT arm viewer LEFT extends down fist at hip, LEFT arm viewer RIGHT bent fist forward upper waist. Preserve source head shape and clenched hands with holes for now-missing rein; do NOT add rein or weapon. Crossed tunic with collar opening, long wrap diagonal sash, broad belt, layered skirt tabs and high boots, muted earth/cream pigments. Isolate figure only, no large Buddha or lions behind. Reconstruction rotate azimuth to frontal while preserve raised chin and lunge. Restoration use conservative ivory ochre brown with sparse surviving blue, skin painted clay warm pale ochre NOT gilded.
HYPOTHETICAL PRE-WEATHERING appearance: depict this exact sculpture freshly completed, before deterioration. Repair only damage, keep all original geometry. Continuous CLEAN paint surfaces, intact gilding where evidenced, NO weathering, NO dirt speckles, NO dark stains, NO chips, NO cracks, NO peeling, NO patina. Existing pale exposed ground patches on face/chest that clearly interrupt gilding should become continuous subdued gold. Preserve subtle handmade clay grain and brush texture, not distressed texture. Conservatively reconstruct only colors evidenced by surviving pigment; no arbitrary elaborate patterns, ornaments, fantasy jewels or newly invented objects. This is plausible pre-weathering appearance, not a claim of verified original Liao paint. Critical surface requirement: remove the reference's dirt and distressed look from EVERY surface including clothes, base and animal. Fresh continuous pigment; subtle handmade brush marks only. Use no artificial aging. Maintain realistic non-glossy sculpture finish.
